senses.definition: A formal binding agreement concluded by subjects of international law, namely, states and international organizations; a convention, a pact.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: Chiefly in in treaty: discussions or negotiations in order to reach an agreement.
senses.example: To a meeting of the executors of late Viscˢˢᵉ Mordaunt's estate, to consider of the sale of Parsons Greene; being in treaty with Mr. Loftus, and to settle the halfe yeare's account.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: Chiefly in private treaty: an agreement or settlement reached following negotiations; a compact, a contract, a covenant.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: The manner or process of treating someone or something; treatment; also, the manner in which someone or something acts or behaves; behaviour.
senses.example: Hoſ[t]. They call me Good-ſtock. / Lov[el]. Sir, and you confeſſe it, / Both i'your language, treaty, and your bearing.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: The addressing or consideration of a subject; discussion, treatment.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: A formal, systematic discourse on some subject; a treatise.
senses.example: And though Galen doth ſometime nibble at Moſes, and beſide the Apoſtate Chriſtian, ſome Heathens have queſtioned his Philoſophicall part or treaty of the Creation: Yet is there ſurely no reaſonable Pagan, that will not admire the rationall and well grounded precepts of Chriſt; […]
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: An act of beseeching or entreating; an entreaty, a plea, a request.
senses.example: Now I must / To the young man ſend humble Treaties, dodge / And palter in the ſhifts of lovvnes, vvho / VVith halfe the bulke o' th' vvorld plaid as I pleas'd, / Making, and marring Fortunes.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance

senses.definition: To get into (a specific situation) through a treaty.
wordFamily: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance
